AuthRepository.joinRole executes the following database operations in one Prisma interactive transaction; early missing-role / already-assigned result has no writes
If Prisma P2002 occurs anywhere in joinRole: rollback transaction; AuthService maps the unique constraint error to 409 RoleAlreadyAssignedException
TokenService.signAccessToken({ userId, roleId: result.role.id, roleName: result.role.name, sessionId }): sign JWT for the existing session
Next.js /api/auth proxy sets accessToken cookie and returns { roleName: body.role }; on initial backend 401, refresh tokens and retry once if refresh succeeds
